violation_type.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

finding_variants.text: There was no admission information available for children in care.

6 of 7 children's records were reviewed and the following was determined:    Two needed school information.   Three needed emergency contact information.  Four needed a special needs statement.   One needed a health statement.  Two needed updated immunization records.   One child's record was unavailable for review.
Two out of six children were missing admission information.

Admission records were reviewed for five children enrolled and the following was determined:    Five needed an address for the emergency contact.   Five needed a special needs statement.   Four needed the admission date.   Three needed release persons.   One needed an updated immunization record.   One needed emergency care information.

Four children did not have an emergency contact address, two children did not have physician information, one child did not have authorization to obtain emergency medical treatment, and one child did not have completed parent rights form.
It was noticed that the caregiver did not have the admission information for one child in care during inspection.
